FAQ’s

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built=”1″ custom_padding_last_edited=”on|phone” _builder_version=”4.16″ custom_padding_tablet=”|15px||15px” custom_padding_phone=”0px|15px|0px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_row custom_padding_last_edited=”off|desktop” _builder_version=”4.16″ width=”auto” width_tablet=”” width_phone=”90%” width_last_edited=”on|phone” max_width=”680px” module_alignment=”center” custom_margin_phone=”|0px||0px” custom_margin_last_edited=”off|desktop” custom_padding_phone=”35px|0px|35px|0px|true|false” use_custom_width=”on” width_unit=”off” custom_width_percent=”100%” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”4_4″ _builder_version=”4.16″ custom_padding=”|||” custom_padding_tablet=”|30px||” custom_padding_phone=”|0px||0px||true” custom_padding_last_edited=”off|desktop” global_colors_info=”{}” padding_phone=”|0px||” padding_tablet=”|30px||” padding_last_edited=”on|phone” custom_padding__hover=”|||”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”Heebo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.9em” header_font=”Poppins|700||on|||||” header_text_align=”left” header_text_color=”#1E73B9″ header_font_size=”3vw” custom_margin=”||1px|||” text_font_size_tablet=”18px” text_font_size_phone=”15px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”5vw” header_font_size_phone=”7vw” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}”]

our answers to your questions

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_divider color=”#BB1C29″ divider_position=”center” divider_weight=”3px” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”0px||5px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_divider][et_pb_toggle title=”What are the Signs that the roof on your home needs repair?” open_toggle_background_color=”#C6C6C6″ closed_toggle_text_color=”#FFFFFF” closed_toggle_background_color=”#1E73B9″ icon_color=”#FFFFFF” open_icon_color=”#FFFFFF” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”||0px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”]

  • Leaking or dark spots on walls
  • Warped shingles
  • Missing shingles
  • Sagging roof
  • Exposed nails. This means shingles are breaking and loosening which could lead to holes in the roof.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_divider color=”#BB1C29″ divider_position=”center” divider_weight=”3px” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”0px||5px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_divider][et_pb_toggle title=”What are the Signs that the roof on your commercial property needs repair?” open_toggle_background_color=”#C6C6C6″ closed_toggle_text_color=”#FFFFFF” closed_toggle_background_color=”#1E73B9″ icon_color=”#FFFFFF” open_icon_color=”#FFFFFF” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”||0px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”]

  • Splitting or cracking in the roof membrane
  • Water stains on the ceiling
  • Pooling water on the roof might mean the roof is not draining properly
  • Any signs of mold

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_divider color=”#BB1C29″ divider_position=”center” divider_weight=”3px” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”0px||5px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_divider][et_pb_toggle title=”How Do You Decide if a roof needs to be Repaired or replaced?” open_toggle_background_color=”#C6C6C6″ closed_toggle_text_color=”#FFFFFF” closed_toggle_background_color=”#1E73B9″ icon_color=”#FFFFFF” open_icon_color=”#FFFFFF” _builder_version=”4.20.4″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”||0px||false|false” hover_enabled=”0″ global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

  • If we feel we can repair your roof and increase its life, that is what we will recommend.
  • If we feel that it is beyond repair and would not make economical sense to prolong the current roof, we will then provide options to replace the roof.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_divider color=”#BB1C29″ divider_position=”center” divider_weight=”3px” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”0px||5px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_divider][et_pb_toggle title=”How Long Will The Repair Process Take?” open_toggle_background_color=”#C6C6C6″ closed_toggle_text_color=”#FFFFFF” closed_toggle_background_color=”#1E73B9″ icon_color=”#FFFFFF” open_icon_color=”#FFFFFF” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”||0px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”]

  • Repairs usually take about 1 to 2 days to complete. However, this timeline depends on the size of the project and roof system.
  • The process may also go quicker or last longer than expected depending on the weather.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_divider color=”#BB1C29″ divider_position=”center” divider_weight=”3px” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”0px||5px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_divider][et_pb_toggle title=”What are the types of roofing systems?” open_toggle_background_color=”#C6C6C6″ closed_toggle_text_color=”#FFFFFF” closed_toggle_background_color=”#1E73B9″ icon_color=”#FFFFFF” open_icon_color=”#FFFFFF” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”||0px||false|false” global_colors_info=”{}”]

  • We have experience in all roofing materials, from impact resistant shingles, architectural shingles, wood shake and slate.
  • We can help you decide which type of roof will fit your budget and needs.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]
